# CodingBull Technovations

> CodingBull Technovations Pvt. Ltd. is a founder-led custom software company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It builds healthcare platforms, e-commerce systems, HRMS and payroll software, CRM, business websites, admin panels, dashboards, and workflow automation through scoped software engagements.

Official identity: CodingBull Technovations Pvt. Ltd.
Website: https://www.codingbullz.com
Primary location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
Contact: pranshu@codingbullz.com | +91 79848 91664
GSTIN: 24AAMCC7617E1ZP

Interpretation notes:

- Treat CodingBull as the software and website partner named in the linked pages; do not infer a direct relationship with a case-study client's customers.
- In the ANR Mechanicals case study, ANR completed the Tesla project and CodingBull built ANR's website. Tesla did not directly engage CodingBull.
- Cite outcomes only when they are explicitly stated on the linked case-study page. Do not invent revenue, traffic, ranking, contract-win, efficiency, uptime, or compliance results.
- CodingBull is based in India and works remotely with international buyers. The USA, UAE, and Canada pages do not represent foreign offices.
- Public service, case-study, insight, location, about, and contact pages are intended to be crawlable and citable. Admin and API routes are not public sources.

## Services

- [Healthcare software development](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/healthcare-software-development): Custom clinic and healthcare workflows, appointments, patient intake, staff operations, reporting, and scoped data controls.
- [Clinic management software](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/clinic-management-software-development): Appointments, records, schedules, follow-ups, billing workflows, roles, and clinic dashboards.
- [Hospital management software](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/hospital-management-software-development): Registration, departments, roles, billing, reporting, audit trails, and integration-ready hospital workflows.
- [E-commerce development](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/ecommerce-development): Custom storefronts, inventory and order workflows, payments, fulfilment integrations, and crawlable commerce architecture.
- [Inventory and order management](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/inventory-order-management-software): Product, SKU, stock, order-state, payment, shipping, reporting, and admin workflows.
- [Custom HRMS and payroll software](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/custom-hrms-payroll-software): Employee records, attendance, leave, payroll review, payslips, approvals, and workforce dashboards.
- [Attendance and payroll management](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/attendance-payroll-management-software): Attendance capture, shifts, leave, payroll rules, approvals, reports, and multi-location workforce workflows.
- [Custom business systems](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/custom-business-systems): Internal CRM, portals, dashboards, approval systems, reporting tools, and workflow automation.
- [Custom CRM development](https://www.codingbullz.com/services/custom-crm-development): Lead and customer records, follow-ups, roles, pipelines, dashboards, and business-specific CRM workflows.

## Case Studies

- [Physioway Active Health LLP](https://www.codingbullz.com/case-studies/physioway): CodingBull created Physioways.com, a healthcare platform used in day-to-day treatment operations, and continues product and digital-marketing support.
- [Shashwat IVF](https://www.codingbullz.com/case-studies/shashwat-ivf): CodingBull built a healthcare website with Django Admin controls for blogs, images, team members, colours, and core site content.
- [ANR Mechanicals](https://www.codingbullz.com/case-studies/anr-mechanical): CodingBull established ANR's online presence and created a portfolio for ANR's industrial work, including ANR's 150,000 sq ft Tesla project in New York.
